run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion training to learn a placeholder token embedding from a dataset of images
run_quantized_unet_training: run training with quantization-aware training and distillation on the UNet using neural compressor
create_textual_inversion_dataset: create a TextualInversionDataset that loads images, applies transforms, and returns tokenized prompts with pixel values
create_ema_model: create an EMAModel to maintain exponential moving averages of model parameters during training
save_textual_inversion_embeddings: save learned placeholder token embeddings from the text encoder to a binary file
